instruction:
On DailyMed, search for LIPITOR. Open the non-repackaged result titled LIPITOR (atorvastatin calcium) tablet, film coated whose Packager is Viatris Specialty LLC. Report the page label title, Packager, Initial U.S. Approval year, dosage form and all strengths from section 3, and, from Ingredients and Appearance, Route of Administration, active Ingredient Name, and Basis of Strength.

Stopping condition: Stop after the selected label, packager, approval year, dosage form, four strengths, route, active ingredient, and basis of strength have been recorded.

Constraints:
- Use only the supplied DailyMed site and the Viatris Specialty LLC non-repackaged LIPITOR result.
- Do not use either result explicitly marked This is a repackaged label.
- Open the relevant label sections rather than inferring fields from the product name.
- Keep Ingredient Name and Basis of Strength distinct and preserve the four strengths exactly as displayed.
